mapper.select: SELECT id, name, icon, description, is_hot, is_show_home, sort_order, status, product_count, create_time, update_time FROM category ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, icon, description, is_hot, is_show_home, sort_order, status, product_count, create_time, update_time FROM category WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, name, icon, description, is_hot, is_show_home, sort_order, status, product_count, create_time, update_time FROM category WHERE status = 1 AND is_show_home = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, icon, description, is_hot, is_show_home, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{icon}, #{description}, #{isHot}, #{isShowHome}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name}, icon = #{icon}, description = #{description}, is_hot = #{isHot}, is_show_home = #{isShowHome}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE category SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE category SET product_count = #{count}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
